headline: Last session: Sensex tumbled 876 points and Nifty dropped to 22,888 amid heavy banking and IT sector sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today, October 20, 2026, in observance of the Dussehra holiday
In the previous session, the Sensex crashed 876.37 points due to heavy selling in banking and IT sectors
Global market sentiment was dampened by weakening shares in China and Hong Kong as stimulus bets eased
Rising fuel costs are putting pressure on profit margins for major industrial players like UltraTech Cement
whatHappening: Paras Healthcare successfully raised Rs 652 crore from anchor investors before its IPO opens on October 21
Bajaj Finance is in focus following the announcement of its second-quarter financial results
The Indian government clarified it has no plans to regulate airfares except during emergency situations
Jaguar unveiled a new 130,000-pound electric car as part of the brand's global reboot
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Dussehra following a sharp 876-point decline in the Sensex during the previous session. Banking and IT sectors led the losses on Monday, while global sentiment was dampened by cooling stimulus bets in China. Corporate focus remains on the upcoming Paras Healthcare IPO and recent Q2 earnings reports.
